importantFindings.title: The 'replaced build stays until its owner check PASSED' gate is opt-in and fails open, so a pin can overwrite a build whose owner check is still pending, or ship a lower patch
importantFindings.evidence: scripts/test-site-contract.mjs:54 only consults owner-checks.json when the pin declares `replaces` AND pin.activeVersion === pin.replaces.activeVersion. scripts/test-site-contract.mjs:33 skips the downgrade check when activeVersion is null. Nothing checks that pin.activeVersion belongs to pin.versions or to replaces.versions, and nothing compares it with the live build-info.json in the test repository that the publisher already clones. docs/DEPLOY.md:134 says 'The installed build stays fixed until its owner check is resolved' and that the contract refuses a replacement before the PASS. The code does not enforce that.
importantFindings.reproduction: In my scratchpad's r4/probe.mjs I called assertTestPublicationAllowed with an owner-check queue in which D4-PHONE-TRANSFER is NEEDS_SETUP and D3-PHONE-UPDATE is READY. All four calls returned ALLOWED: (1) a D5 pin with versions ['0.4.3'], activeVersion '0.4.2' and no `replaces` field, which overwrites the pending D4 build; (2) a D4 pin that declares replaces D3 (activeVersion '0.4.1') but has activeVersion null; (3) the same pin with versions ['0.4.0'], which publishes 0.4.0 over a live 0.4.1, a downgrade; (4) a pin with a stale activeVersion '0.4.0' that does not match replaces.activeVersion '0.4.1'. Expected: every call refused. Not a blocker: each case needs someone writing an inconsistent pin, and source verification (exact commit, green CI, clean recorded evidence, reviews) still applies, so no unverified code can ship. The cost is the owner's evidence: the build under check can change without anyone noticing. Fix: if pin.activeVersion is set and is not one of pin.versions, require pin.replaces with replaces.activeVersion === pin.activeVersion and a PASSED check whenever replaces.milestone differs from pin.milestone. Refuse a null activeVersion once a pin has replaces. Assert that the cloned output's build-info.json version equals pin.activeVersion. Add each of the four cases above as a test in scripts/test-site-contract.test.mjs.
importantFindings.specRef: docs/DEPLOY.md (phone-test publication); AGENTS.md §17 (physical-device evidence belongs to the owner)

importantFindings.title: The publication gate trusts uncommitted working-tree copies of the pin and the owner-check queue
importantFindings.evidence: scripts/deploy-test-site.mjs:26 and :37 read .milestones/test-site.json and .milestones/owner-checks.json from the working tree. The only Git check on the root is `merge-base --is-ancestor source HEAD` (:46). No clean-tree check exists, and nothing requires the PASSED status the gate depends on to be committed.
importantFindings.reproduction: Code reading: an uncommitted local edit that sets D4-PHONE-TRANSFER to PASSED satisfies the gate at test-site-contract.mjs:54-63 and leaves no committed trace until after publication. Fix: read both files with `git show HEAD:<path>` and require `git status --porcelain -- .milestones` to be empty before publishing.
importantFindings.specRef: AGENTS.md §8 and §17: owner acceptance is a recorded decision, never forged

qolFindings.title: A cleanup step that fails every time now locks the app on the reset screen at every open
qolFindings.evidence: src/App.tsx:833-840 always resumes the reset while the mark exists. src/persistence/localDataOperations.ts:110-113 removes the mark only after clearAppBrowserStorage succeeds. On failure the only control is 'Riprova la cancellazione' (src/App.tsx:897-903).
qolFindings.reproduction: Code reading, plus the unit test 'keeps the mark when deletion or cleanup fails'. If caches.keys(), a service-worker unregister or the Tesseract transaction rejects on every attempt, the app never reaches course creation until the user clears site data by hand. This fails closed, which is right for privacy (no half-deleted course opens), but there is no way out. Better suited to a field-UX or data-integrity backlog note than to a privacy fix.
